The '''Whirlwinds''' were a sentient humanoid species who were presumably composed of gaseous compounds. A Whirlwind was present at [[Crseih Station]]'s [[Crater Lodge]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] where [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hethrir]] and other members of the Empire Reborn movement were lodging while trading in kidnapped alien slaves and paying a visit to the Universe-traveling "faith-healer" [[Waru]], whom presumably healed the creature.
